constraints.action: receive at least 5 cmH2O of positive end-expiratory pressure (PEEP) at time of diagnosis
use low tidal volume ventilation strategies (i.e., 4–8 ml/kg PBW)
measure and adjust Vt using PBW
use of prolonged high-pressure recruitment maneuvers (airway pressure ≥ 35 cmH2O for at least one minute)

constraints.before_action: period of stabilization during which low tidal volume is applied and PEEP adjusted

constraints.action: apply proning for prolonged sessions (16 consecutive hours or more)
routine use of continuous infusions of NMBA to reduce mortality in patients with moderate-to-severe ARDS not due to COVID-19
treat patients with severe ARDS with ECMO in an ECMO center which meets defined organizational standards, adhering to a management strategy similar to that used in the EOLIA trial
provide an ECMO team with capacity to transfer patients on ECMO (mobile ECMO) when centralizing patients from non-ECMO centers
use of ECCO2R for the treatment of ARDS to prevent mortality outside of randomized controlled trials
